newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Mobil Nigeria 9-mth profit down 21.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mobil Nigeria 9-mth profit down 21.7 pct.

text.p: Mobil Nigeria, one of the leading quoted oil products marketers on Nigeria's stock exchange on Friday announced a net profit for nine months to end-September at 785.4 million naira from 956.3 million naira in the same 1995 period.
It represented a 21.7 percent decline on the previous nine months and Nigerian stock traders said it was in line with their expectations.
Mobil shares traded steady at 42.40 naira on the announcement, causing cautious trading in other oil shares.

Unipetrol whose half-year result on Thursday showed a slight improvement, was one of three gainers in the sector comprising eight companies. It rose 30 kobo to 45.80 naira, the same as African Petroleum which closed at 36.00 naira.
Total, which opened the floodgate of poor results on Monday, was unchanged at 50.00 naira.
Mobil said turnover fell to 8.5 billion naira from nine billion naira in the same period in 1995 while profit before taxation dipped to 1.1 billion naira from 1.5 billion naira.
It did not give any explanation for the fall but analysts said the company was suffering from a lower profit margin plaguing all oil products marketers operating in the country.
